synthesis:draft.headline: Dispatch five-minute TOTALDEMAND highest in the returned 5-minute fields at 2026-07-29 19:35 AEST (2026-07-29T09:35:00Z): 10,890.3 MW.
summary: Highest observed dispatch five-minute TOTALDEMAND in the returned 5-minute fields: 10,890.3 MW at interval ending 2026-07-29 19:35 AEST (2026-07-29T09:35:00Z).
TOTALDEMAND at the price-peak interval (interval ending 2026-07-29 20:05 AEST / 2026-07-29T10:05:00Z) was 10,761.01 MW.
Half-hour operational demand (a different measure) had a maximum of 11,079.0 MW at interval ending 2026-07-29 19:00 AEST (2026-07-29T09:00:00Z).
AEMO published a market notice for NSW1 that declared unit WTAHB1 non-conforming on 29 July 2026 (see published_findings).

possible_explanations.statement: The AEMO non-conformance notice for unit WTAHB1 [c1] might be relevant to system conditions on 29 July 2026.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit availability and dispatch records for WTAHB1 for 29/07/2026 (the notice's text describes the non-conformance) and compare to dispatch TOTALDEMAND and scheduled generation for intervals around 29/07/2026 13:55 to 14:15 NEM time as reported in the notice [c1].

possible_explanations.statement: The large net interconnector flow into NSW1 at the dispatch TOTALDEMAND peak might indicate substantial imports at that time and could be relevant to the dispatch demand balance.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the full interconnector flow series and regional dispatch supply components across the 5-minute intervals around 2026-07-29 19:35 AEST (2026-07-29T09:35:00Z) to see whether imports (e.g. ev0723) were concurrent with the observed dispatch TOTALDEMAND peak (ev0704).

possible_explanations.statement: The half-hour operational demand maximum being larger than the peak five-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND might reflect differences between the two measures (half-hour averaging versus five-minute dispatch).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the complete 5-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND series for the window and compute half-hour averages aligned with the operational demand intervals to reconcile the two measures (compare the full 5-minute series to the half-hour operational demand series).
